name: gce-pytorch-v6e1-2b
description: Compute Engine DevOps for the PyTorch/XLA Gemma 4 E2B rig: flex-start ct6e-standard-1t provisioning, capacity probing, quotas, cost estimates, and SRE diagnostics via the gce-pytorch-v6e1-2b MCP server. Serves google/gemma-4-E2B-it on one TPU v6e chip through public torch_xla (device "xla"), with the xprof + tensorboard profiling kit installed at boot.
